A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VGG-Flow research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, table, and Appendices A-F are readable and directly comparable. V2 additionally includes a NeurIPS checklist.

before.justification: V1 reports original Stable Diffusion 3 alignment experiments, including reward, diversity, and FID results in Table 1, ablations, and generated-image comparisons in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results, including Table 1, convergence and ablation plots, and the qualitative comparisons in Appendices D-F.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, the objectives, value-gradient parametrization, and model architecture remain unchanged. Appendix C.2 newly documents CFG composition and unconditional-branch gradient stopping, without establishing a change to the previously used procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same text-to-image alignment tasks, animal prompts, HPDv2 photo/painting prompts, and PickScore-associated prompt set. No additional dataset, domain, or test scenario is evaluated.

E2.justification: Table 1 and the corresponding figures retain the same comparators: base SD3, ReFL, DRaFT, Adjoint Matching, and VGG-Flow-PMP. No comparator is added, removed, or substantively revised.

E3.justification: The stated sampling procedure, training budgets, batch sizes, metrics, and hyperparameters are retained, including CFG scale 5.0. The added CFG explanation documents an existing experimental setting rather than reporting a revised protocol.

E4.justification: The reward-temperature, eta-schedule, and transition-subsampling ablations, along with the sample-evolution comparisons, are unchanged. The new gradient-stopping remark is not accompanied by an additional ablation or supporting analysis.

E5.justification: V1 already reports three random seeds and displays uncertainty values. V2's checklist item 7 newly identifies the reported uncertainty as standard deviation across random seeds. This clarifies reporting without indicating additional runs or new statistical tests.

E6.justification: Table 1, all plotted results, and generated-image comparisons are unchanged. Appendix C.2 adds the qualitative observation that stopping gradients through the unconditional velocity leads to faster convergence, without new numerical measurements or comparison curves.

T1.justification: The HJB and PMP derivations, propositions, distribution bounds, and proofs in Appendices A-B are unchanged. The added standard CFG formula explains implementation rather than introducing a new theoretical result or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about efficient alignment, reward convergence, diversity, and prior preservation.

C2.justification: The interpretations of performance tradeoffs and HJB versus PMP, together with the relaxed-objective, approximation-bias, and mode-collapse limitations, are unchanged. The checklist refers back to the existing discussion rather than adding substantive limitations or mechanism explanations.

D1.justification: Appendix C.2 newly specifies CFG composition for both base and finetuned velocity fields and stopping gradients through the unconditional branch. The project address changes from vggflow.github.io to vggflow25.github.io. The checklist also states code release and planned documentation, although external availability cannot be verified from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and 80-reference bibliography are unchanged. The checklist's policy links do not add research comparisons or alter novelty claims.

P1.justification: V2 expands one implementation paragraph, updates the project-link/header text, and appends a structured NeurIPS checklist. The main narrative and existing appendix organization remain unchanged; there is no extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: All 20 figures, Table 1, and Algorithm 1 retain their presentation and placement. Layout changes are limited to the first-page link area, local paragraph reflow in Appendix C.2, and the appended checklist pages.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves limited reporting ambiguities by specifying CFG composition and unconditional-branch gradient stopping in Appendix C.2 and identifying standard deviations across seeds in the checklist. These details improve reproducibility and interpretation. The scientific evidence remains unchanged, and the added convergence-speed observation has no supporting new analysis, so the improvement is modest.
